output.scope_note: The paper reports MLMD-computed ionic conductivities of the solid superionic conductor AgCrSe2 (Ag+ mobile ion) under oscillating electric fields, so it is in scope with computational data.

records.measurement_method: machine-learning molecular dynamics (MLMD) with oscillating out-of-plane field Ez0 = 0.03 V Å−1 at f = 0.05 THz
records.evidence_quote: producing a dynamically disordered state with conductivity of 1.7 S cm−1
records.notes: Mobile ion is Ag+ (not Li/Na, so coded 'other'). Field-driven nonequilibrium value (in-plane probe field, out-of-plane oscillating drive), not an equilibrium superionic value; the abstract gives the same ~1.7 S cm-1 at 300 K. Activation energy of 97 meV in the paper refers to the equilibrium Arrhenius fit above 450 K and is not assigned here.

records.measurement_method: machine-learning molecular dynamics (MLMD) with oscillating out-of-plane field Ez0 = 0.03 V Å−1 at f = 0.01 THz
records.evidence_quote: The resulting ionic conductivity reaches ∼ 0.9 S cm−1
records.notes: Mobile ion is Ag+ (coded 'other'). Field-driven value at f = 0.01 THz (complete switching regime); the text gives ~0.9 S/cm, the Fig. 2 caption gives sigma ~ 0.9 S cm-1 for the same condition.
